title: Polish Lamb Skewers
description: A traditional Polish dish featuring tender lamb cooked to perfection on skewers. This recipe is perfect for a summer evening or a backyard barbecue.

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: Make sure to trim excess fat

ingredients.name: Polish seasoning blend
ingredients.notes: Available at most grocery stores or online

instructions: 2. Thread lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
3. In a small bowl, mix together olive oil, Polish seasoning blend, and garlic. Brush mixture onto lamb cubes.
4. Season skewers with salt and pepper to taste.
5. Place skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
6. Roast lamb skewers in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until cooked through.
7. Garnish with chopped parsley and serve with lemon wedges.
8. If using, top skewers with roasted red peppers.
